raw_text: Integrate literary, expository, and opinion (grades K-5) or rhetorical (grades 6-12) elements to appeal to target audiences and achieve specific purposes. (I/C)
competency_statement: Integrate elements from literary, expository, and opinion texts to appeal to a specific audience and achieve a particular purpose.
observable_behaviors: Combine features from different types of texts such as stories, informational writing, and opinions in their own writing.
Make choices about text elements to suit the audience's interests and the writing's purpose.
Use knowledge of different text types to enhance writing effectiveness.
skill_clauses: Integrate literary elements to appeal to target audiences.
Integrate expository elements to appeal to target audiences.
Integrate opinion elements to appeal to target audiences.

student_actions.written_production: Combine literary, expository, and opinion elements in writing to appeal to an audience and fulfill a purpose.
student_actions.procedural_application: Apply knowledge of different text elements to create writing that suits the audience and purpose.
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Explain how integrating different text elements helps appeal to the audience and achieve the writing purpose.
